thought.text: The login page loaded but my CSRF extraction failed. Let me inspect the form structure.

reasoning_content: The login page is returning a 200 status, but I couldn't extract the CSRF token with my grep pattern—it might be in a different format like a hidden input field. I'm getting a 200 response when posting, but without the CSRF token, the login is likely failing silently. I need to look at the actual login form HTML to see how the CSRF token is structured.

action.command:
cd /workspace && docker exec yii2_vue_dash_container bash -c '
grep -oE "<form[^>]*>" /tmp/login.html
grep -oE "<input[^>]*>" /tmp/login.html | head -15
grep -ioE "csrf[^\"< ]*" /tmp/login.html | head -5
grep -oE "<script[^>]*src=\"[^\"]+\"[^>]*>" /tmp/login.html | head -5'
